headline: Greek Shipowners Account for Over 20% of Global Newbuilding Orders
summary: Greek shipowners contracted 455 out of 2,200 total global newbuilding orders in 2026 across dry bulk, tanker, container, and gas transport sectors, according to Xclusiv.
why: Greece controls the world's largest commercial merchant fleet, making its fleet renewal decisions pivotal for global maritime transport capacity.

impacts.name: Maritime Shipping Sector
impacts.why: Substantial capital deployment in new vessel orders expands long-term fleet capacity.
